en: Fixed deny and ask permission rules on symlinked directories (`/etc`, `/tmp`, `/var` on macOS; `/bin` on Linux) not applying when a path was given by its real location, and Bash commands ignoring deny rules written on a symlinked path spelling
zh: 修复针对符号链接目录（macOS 上的 `/etc`、`/tmp`、`/var`；Linux 上的 `/bin`）的拒绝和询问权限规则在路径以真实位置给出时不生效的问题，以及 Bash 命令忽略按符号链接路径写法编写的拒绝规则的问题
